lines.zh: 我在湿石上滑了一小段。
lines.en: I slide a stretch on the wet stone.

lines.zh: 我扑腾着往前，肚子贴地。
lines.en: I paddle forward, belly to the ground.

lines.zh: 我从一块石板滑到另一块。
lines.en: I slide from one slab to the next.
I make my way toward the water.
My head is too big; it wobbles as I go.

lines.zh: 我贴着光滑的地面滑行。
lines.en: I glide over the smooth ground.
I go around a stone and slide further.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，身子转了个弯。
lines.en: One flick of my tail turns me.
I drag myself along, clumsy.
I slide from the grass into the mud.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地滑向有水的方向。
lines.en: I slide slowly toward the water.
I tilt, recover, and keep sliding.

lines.zh: 我把自己挪到石板中间。
lines.en: I shift to the middle of the slab.
I paddle twice in the shallows.
I crawl ashore, dripping.
I slide along the bank a while.

lines.zh: 我撞到石头，头偏了一下。
lines.en: I bump a stone and my head turns.
I move slowly, unhurried.
I lie on the stone; it's cool.
I rest my head on the edge.
I blow a bubble.

lines.zh: 泥没过了我的半边脑袋。
lines.en: Mud covers half of my head.
I watch the light on the water.

lines.zh: 我的头骨形状很奇怪吧。
lines.en: My skull's shape is strange, isn't it?
I soak in the shallows, doing nothing.
A bug lands on my head.

lines.zh: 我把一双眼睛轮流合上。
lines.en: I close my two eyes one after the other.
I remember the dark in the mud.

lines.zh: 我用尾尖在水面点了一下。
lines.en: I dab the water's surface with my tail tip.
I smell rain.
I'm waiting for the sun to weaken.

lines.zh: 我在石头上磨了磨肚子。
lines.en: I rub my belly on the stone.

lines.zh: 我把头缩了一下，又伸出来。
lines.en: I tuck my head in, then out again.
I'm soft, and slow.
You stand at the water's edge, blocking the light.
I look up; my neck doesn't quite work.
You're so tall, and I'm so low.
I awkwardly turn halfway round.
You're reaching — to catch me?
I smell water on you.

lines.zh: 我看着你，只想继续趴着。
lines.en: I look at you and just want to keep lying here.

lines.zh: 你矮下身子，我才整个露出来。
lines.en: You lowered yourself, and only then was all of me in view.
My eyes sit on top of my head.
I won't run; I can't run fast.
Don't step on my tail.
Water drips from your hand.
I slide off and hit a stone.

lines.zh: 我仰面朝天，慢慢翻回来。
lines.en: I end up on my back and slowly roll over.

lines.zh: 我滑回浅水，藏起半个头。
lines.en: I slide back into the shallows, half my head hidden.
My head swims; I pause.
I shake, and droplets fly.
I don't cry out; I only swim away.
I lie flat and recover.
My skin is broken a little, shallow.

lines.zh: 我钻回泥里，只露出头顶。
lines.en: I burrow back into the mud, only my crown showing.
I can still move, slower.

lines.zh: 水里有点动静，我去看看。
lines.en: Something stirs in the water; I'll look.
Is that a bug in your hand?
Somewhere wet; I prefer that.
I slide a little your way.
That sound of water makes me hungry.
Just set it by the water.
I smell something soft.
I crawl over quietly.
I can reach that bite.
I want to slide a little closer.
The water in your palm; I can reach it.
If there's a bug, hand it over slowly.
I smell something in the wet mud.
Come a little closer to the water.
That small stir makes me want to move.
I raise my head slowly to sniff.
One touch and I slide half a foot.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻了个身，慢慢正过来。
lines.en: The bump flips me; I right myself slowly.

lines.zh: 我的湿肚子擦过你的鞋。
lines.en: My wet belly brushes against your shoe.
My head knocks your boot.
We meet, and I stick for a moment.
You step on my tail, and I jerk.

lines.zh: 我贴在你鞋上，滑不下来。
lines.en: I cling to your shoe and can't slide off.
I retreat and slide into the water.
Bumping doesn't hurt; I'm soft.

lines.zh: 我们分开，各自稳了一下。
lines.en: We part and each steady ourselves.
Another pokes its head out of the water.
Her head is a little wider.

lines.zh: 我和它挤在同一块石板上。
lines.en: It and I squeeze onto the same stone slab.
She slides further than I do.
We lay eggs by the water together.
She rests her head against mine.
We burrow into the mud together.
She blows a bubble; I blow one too.
We circle in the shallows.
Two clumsy ones, sliding slowly.
I catch a small bug.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的东西推到水边。
lines.en: I push what you dropped to the water.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块湿石头，很滑。
lines.en: I pick up a wet stone; it's slippery.

lines.zh: 我用头推了一下那根树枝。
lines.en: I nudge that branch with my head.

lines.zh: 我把一片叶子按在泥里。
lines.en: I press a leaf into the mud.
I bite your rope and drag it.

lines.zh: 我把水里的东西捞起来。
lines.en: I scoop something out of the water.
I push an egg along, slowly.

lines.zh: 我把那块骨头拖到石头上。
lines.en: I drag that bone onto the stone.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片水草，闻了闻。
lines.en: I pick up a bit of waterweed and sniff.

lines.zh: 我盯住了岸边那点动静。
lines.en: I fix on that little stir by the bank.
I smell bugs.

lines.zh: 我贴地朝那片水痕滑去。
lines.en: I slide low toward that wet trail.
That wet stone is my path.
I've chosen: over there.

lines.zh: 我把宽脑袋慢慢转向那边。
lines.en: I swing my broad head slowly that way.
That sound isn't far.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来看了一下。
lines.en: I raise my head to look once.

lines.zh: 我撑起前肢，认准了方向。
lines.en: I push up on my forelimbs, fixed on a direction.
I make for the shallows.
I drag my belly over, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我在石头上滑，没有声音。
lines.en: I slide on stone without a sound.
It's behind that stone.
I crouch on the stone and wait for it to move again.
I keep my head low to the ground.

lines.zh: 我和它之间只隔一块石头。
lines.en: Only one stone lies between us.

lines.zh: 水边那块湿的地方更好走。
lines.en: The wet patch by the water is easier.

lines.zh: 我拖着肚子朝它转过去。
lines.en: I drag my belly around toward it.
It moves; I move.
I count how far is left.
I bump it once, softly.
I close my mouth on its toe.
I press it down with my head.
I lash my tail across.
That was as light as slapping water.
I nudge it into the water with my broad head.
It backs off; I stay put.
I close my mouth on it, then let go at once.

lines.zh: 我贴上去，压得它动不了。
lines.en: I press on it until it can't move.
I slid off; I missed.
I crawl out of the water, wet.
The egg hatched on the water's surface.
My first slide on stone.
My head is still wet, and heavy.
The water here is shallow; perfect.
I find a place to lie down.

lines.zh: 黏液把我从化石里拉回来。
lines.en: The slime pulled me back from stone.
I hear water running.
I blow my first bubble.
I make my way slowly to the bank.
My wet trail marks the stone.
I try to stand and can't quite.
The heat tightens my skin.

lines.zh: 我从石头上摔下去，翻了两圈。
lines.en: I fall off the stone, rolling twice.
I take in water and choke.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得滑出去很远。
lines.en: The blast slides me far away.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的头，留下痕。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my head, leaving a line.
A light covers me; I can't move.
I haven't caught a bug in ages.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，我缩进泥里。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water; I shrink into mud.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，也没有石头。
lines.en: There's no water here, and no stone.
